title: Genome-wide approach to study gene-nutrient intake interactions in type 2 diabetes mellitus in a large Korean cohort.
authors: Park JM, Choi JE, Song Y, Kwon YJ, Lee JW, Hong KW.

Signal plots for the statistically significant SNP regions confirmed in a specific diet group. The lead SNPs identified in the GWAS and the ±400-kbp region were plotted.
